name: cookie-audit
description: Cookie-consent / CIPA audit pipeline for ecommerce storefronts: four-consent-state HAR capture, deterministic vendor classification, counsel-facing diagnostic report

interface.shortDescription: Audit what fires before consent, after decline, and under GPC.
interface.longDescription: Forensic cookie-consent audit for ecommerce storefronts: Playwright captures the store in four consent states (none, decline, accept, GPC), a versioned vendor registry classifies every request and cookie deterministically, and the output is a counsel-facing diagnostic report. Diagnosis, never legal adjudication.
defaultPrompt: Run a cookie consent audit on my store.
What fires on my site before the visitor touches the consent banner?
Analyze these HAR files for tracker activity after decline.
